assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Oblique view of the cube ABCD-EFGH (ABCD at the bottom, E, F, G, H above A, B, C, D) with T on AE at height t and P on AB at distance 2t from A; the green line DA is extended beyond A to the point X, where it meets the red line through M (the midpoint of HD) and T and the blue line through C and P.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the observation that the common point must lie on the line DA, so that the problem splits into two plane problems in the faces ADHE and ABCD, each solved with similar triangles.
